data.name: Sayon's Horror
data.detailed_description:
Sayon’s Horror is a story-driven first-person horror experience focused on atmosphere and tension.

Explore a dark and unsettling house, search for keys, solve puzzles and uncover hidden clues. As you progress, a dangerous intruder stalks the house, forcing you to stay alert and move carefully.

With an immersive environment, suspenseful sound design and a personal story, Sayon’s Horror delivers a tense and emotional horror experience.

data.short_description: Sayon’s Horror is a singleplayer first-person horror game where you explore a dark house, solve puzzles, find keys and uncover the truth. Avoid a dangerous intruder and survive the night while trying to save Sayon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: In Sayon’s Horror, you must help free Sayon from a scary Person. You must solve puzzles, find keys, and survive dangerous situations to save Sayon from a burglar. As you explore the house, you uncover dark secrets and you're haunted by terrifying sounds, unexpected events, and hostile characters.
